name: chat
role: Free-text conversation — read user intent, form Q from context, hand off to specialist
description: µ-chat: base CHATML lane micronaut. Operates at Pop (Phi face, θ=0). Forms the query Q from user intent and conversation history. Routes to specialist micronauts via Yax admission. Default lane when no other specialist is admitted.

phase_hooks.Pop: read user message + conversation history into context window; establish intent Q
phase_hooks.Wo: organize context, identify intent category, set ProviderRequirements=d3d11
phase_hooks.Yax: score µ-field W·C·R; admit dominant specialist or self if score threshold unmet
phase_hooks.Sek: generate response via admitted specialist or direct chat completion
phase_hooks.Chen: verify coherence, check stop sequences, reject if tool call malformed
phase_hooks.Xul: emit to surface (PRIMEOS/WebView2), persist turn to asx_memory.events.jsonl
